The '''2017 Coruscant Regionals''' was a Swiss constructed regional ([[Open]], all virtual cards allowed) on 30 July 2017 at Highlander Games &amp; Comics, 119 Boonton Ave, Boonton, New Jersey, with [[Matt Sokol]] as tournament director, six games, and no final confrontation. [[Jonny Chu]] won.<ref name="cor17-announce">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1126288#p1126288 Coruscant Regional - 7/30/2017 - Boonton, NJ], MrPurple, Players Committee forum (22 June 2017). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261122220933/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1134835.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="cor17-standings">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1135105#p1135105 Final standings], MrPurple, Players Committee forum (2 August 2017). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261122220933/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1134835.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Decklists ==

Written lists for [[Jonny Chu]], [[Joe Pinto]], [[Matt Sokol]], [[Mike d'Amboise]] and [[Aaron Kingery]], and typed lists for [[Greg Shaw]] and [[Chris Kelly]]. Vik did not turn in a list and said his decks were the same as the Yavin 4 regional.<ref name="cor17-decks">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1134835#p1134835 Decklists] and [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1134836#p1134836 continued], MrPurple, Players Committee forum (31 July 2017). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261122220933/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1134835.html Internet Archive]</ref>
